tool.name: any_nav
tool.description: Build a routing view from Markdown descriptions under a directory: folders are represented by their README.md (its description, when present). Use before exploring an unfamiliar Markdown knowledge base to pick a folder route. Route lines are always workspace-root-relative full paths (e.g. `guides/containment/containment.md`), never relative to the selected route root, and are sorted case-insensitively by route path. Every line is either a Markdown file route (with ` | description` when the file has one) or a depth-truncated folder rendered as `[truncated: N] folder-path` (with ` | description` when the folder’s README has one), where N is the folder’s recursive .md count (the total that would expand on descent); a folder with no Markdown content under it is omitted entirely, so `[truncated: 0]` never appears. In a `path | description` line, everything after the FIRST ` | ` is the description (it may itself contain ` | `); route paths never contain the separator. `routeCount` counts route entries (files plus truncated folders), not raw .md files or structural tree nodes. In the response, `root` is the absolute workspace root and `anchor` the absolute route root of this view; `depth` is measured from `anchor`, and the requested `routePath` is echoed when one was passed. A description comes from the document itself: frontmatter `description:`, else a `description:` line in its head, else its first substantive prose line. Traversal filters (excluded directory/file names, dot entries, gitignored paths) apply without an echo — a path absent from the view was excluded by policy or holds no Markdown; the only mid-scan cutoff, the maxFiles budget, always reports a warning in `diagnostics`. Returns route paths and descriptions, never file content.

routePath.description: Optional folder route to scan from. "." scans from the root. Use slash-separated folder paths such as Topics, guides, or docs/authoring; do not pass a Markdown file route.

depth.description: Maximum directory depth to expand below the route root (routePath if given, otherwise the workspace root). Depth is measured from that route root, not the workspace root. A folder sitting exactly at the depth boundary is not descended into and is shown as `[truncated: N] folder-path` instead of expanding. Defaults to 0: lists only the route root’s own Markdown files plus each direct sub-folder as its `[truncated: N]` representative.

format.description: Output shape. `flat` (default) returns one route line per entry. `tree` returns nested nodes with the same semantics: a file node has its full `.md` path in `path` and `kind: file`; a truncated folder has `path`, `kind: folder`, `truncated: true`, `omittedMarkdownCount` (the same recursive .md total as flat’s `[truncated: N]`), `markdown` (its README path, when it has one), and `description` (that README’s, when the README has one); an expanded folder has only `path` and `children`.

excludeDirs.description: Comma-separated directory names skipped during traversal. Defaults to the plugin config.

excludeFiles.description: Comma-separated Markdown file names (case-insensitive) excluded from routes, e.g. "AGENTS.md,CLAUDE.md". Defaults to the plugin config.

excludeDotEntries.description: Whether to skip dot entries (names starting with ".") such as .github or .agents. Defaults to true.

maxFiles.description: Maximum Markdown files to read. Defaults to plugin config maxFiles.

respectGitignore.description: Whether to skip paths ignored by .gitignore files during traversal. Defaults to true.
